product_one_liner.value: interface.ai provides agentic voice, chat, and employee AI for credit unions and community banks, automating member service and banking workflows.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes BankGPT and its AI products as built for credit unions and community banks.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer list products, customers, integrations, careers, and contact links but no pricing page or pricing link.

named_customers.notes: Both organizations have dedicated case studies identifying them as customers.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company at 51–200 employees; Tracxn reports 193 employees as of September 30, 2026, which falls in the requested 101–200 band.

hq_location.notes: The company profile identifies San Francisco, California, United States as its headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company profile lists its founding year as 2019.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains marketing, industry education, and product-focused content; it does not show at least two engineering-authored technical posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation and footer provide a Knowledge Center and security information, but no product documentation, developer portal, or help center link; the Knowledge Center is described as ebooks, guides, and strategy resources.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists an Applied AI Engineer, Business Automation role.

model_provider.notes: I checked the public blog, trust/compliance materials, and available product and integration information but found no public statement naming the AI model or model provider used by the product.

compliance_certs.notes: The company names SOC 2 and ISO 27001:2022 on its data-compliance page and lists GDPR among compliance items in its Trust Center. I did not include HIPAA or PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: The October 2024 round was reported as a $30 million Series A; the reported total combines $20 million equity and $10 million debt.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest located round closed in October 2024, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board lists an Account Executive opening.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest launch announcements located were Nexus on April 14, 2026 and Smart Collections on February 19, 2026, both before the six-month window beginning May 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A June 18, 2026 event introduces interface.ai's new executive leaders, including Michael Azevedo as VP, Sales and Bryan Dooley as SVP, Customer Experience, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The integrations page refers generally to CRM and enterprise-system integrations, and the current careers material reviewed did not name a specific CRM or sales/marketing platform.
